{{Top|leg}}
'''Tinial's Tway''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] group that enjoyed great popularity during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Due to their good reputation, the members of Tinial's Tway were among the few musicians who played in the [[Crimson Casino]] Lounge aboard the luxury [[Space station/Legends|space station]] called [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]].
